title: Hold detector model manifest
description: Published to models/hold-detector/<version>/manifest.json in the public media R2 bucket by ml/holds/publish_model.py (epic #5346, SW-01, issue #5434). Consumed by the mobile model loader (issue #5435) and the server-side inference container (issue #5451). Weights are immutable per version; the manifest is the only mutable pointer for a given version, so a bad manifest can be re-published with --force but the weight files it points at never change underneath a version tag.

schemaVersion.description: Bump when a field is renamed or removed. Additive fields do not require a bump — at the top level and inside `training`/`eval`/`outputs`, which stay open for exactly that reason. `input` and each `files` entry are closed instead: they are the preprocessing and integrity contract a consumer implements field by field, so an unrecognised key there is a typo it must not silently ignore.

version.description: Semver (e.g. 1.2.0) or a date tag (e.g. 2026-09-15). Also the immutable R2 prefix models/hold-detector/<version>/.

family.description: Model family as named in ml/holds/configs.json, e.g. rfdetr.

config.description: Name of the ml/holds/configs.json entry this export came from, e.g. nano-tiled-1024.

width.description: Per-tile input width the ONNX graph consumes (config's resolution).

height.description: Per-tile input height the ONNX graph consumes (config's resolution).

dtype.description: The graph's input tensor dtype. int8 export only quantizes weights (dynamic quantization); activations, including the input tensor, stay float32.

letterbox.description: How a crop is fit to width x height before inference. eval.py's OnnxDetector.preprocess resizes each tile directly to (width, height) with PIL bilinear resize and no aspect-preserving padding, i.e. 'stretch' - a tile whose aspect ratio isn't square gets distorted, not letterboxed.

mean.description: Per-RGB-channel mean subtracted after scaling pixels to [0, 1]. eval.py uses the ImageNet statistics RF-DETR was pretrained with.

std.description: Per-RGB-channel standard deviation divided in after mean subtraction.

name.description: ONNX output tensor name. RF-DETR's exporter does not name outputs consistently across versions, so eval.py identifies the boxes tensor by shape (last dimension 4) instead of by name; null here means a consumer must do the same.

format.description: Center x, center y, width, height, each normalized to the tile's [0, 1] range - the RF-DETR convention eval.py decodes.

name.description: ONNX output tensor name, or null to identify by shape (last dimension equal to `classes`), matching eval.py.

activation.description: RF-DETR trains with focal loss, so scores are sigmoid(logits), never softmax.

classes.description: configs.json's num_classes - 1 for every shipped config (single `hold` class).

default.description: The score threshold this version ships as its default, chosen on the `tune` split.

sweep.description: Thresholds evaluated during calibration, for a client-side confidence slider (see ml/holds/README.md, '#5441').

dataset.description: What was trained on, e.g. 'Roboflow climbing-holds-and-volumes v14, 600 photos'.

licence.description: Licence of the training data, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0'. Must be credited on the app licences screen per ml/holds/README.md.

trainedOn.description: Hardware the training run used. publish_model.py's --trained-on CLI flag currently offers 'm5-max-mps' or 'cpu'; the schema stays open-ended so a future device label isn't a schema change.

date.description: ISO date the export was trained/produced.

eval.description: Optional - measured quality of THIS exact export on the held-out spray-wall corpus (ml/holds/README.md, 'Spray walls, held-out'). Omitted when no eval-json was supplied at publish time.

split.description: Which split these numbers were measured on, copied from the eval.py results file (e.g. `eval`, the held-out spray half, vs `tune`, where the threshold was chosen). publish_model.py refuses an eval file whose config, model file or score threshold does not match what is being published.

sprayEvalF1.description: Box F1 @ IoU 0.5 on the spray-wall `eval` split, at the shipped default threshold.

weightedCorrectionsPerHold.description: eval.py's correction_rate_micro: (false positives + misses) / total holds on the spray-wall `eval` split.

gestureSavings.description: Estimated fraction of manual tap-to-place gestures the detector saves a user, relative to placing every hold by hand.

licence.description: Licence of the exported weights themselves (RF-DETR is Apache-2.0). The training data's own licence, which may require app-side attribution, is training.licence.
